description: This file contains serializers, codecs, and copy helpers for various F# types (such as options, choices, lists, sets, maps, references, and results) within the Orleans.Serialization namespace. It implements serialization, deserialization, copying, and surrogate conversion logic for complex F# types to facilitate efficient serialization in Orleans.

classes.name: FSharpUnitCodec
classes.description: Serializer for the F# Unit type, handling null references.

classes.name: FSharpUnitCopier
classes.description: Shallow copier for the F# Unit type.

classes.name: FSharpOptionCodec
classes.description: Serializer for FSharpOption<T>, handling presence and absence of a value.

classes.name: FSharpOptionCopier
classes.description: Deep copier for FSharpOption<T>.

classes.name: FSharpValueOptionCodec
classes.description: Serializer for FSharpValueOption<T>.

classes.name: FSharpValueOptionCopier
classes.description: Deep copier for FSharpValueOption<T>.

classes.name: FSharpChoiceCodec
classes.description: Serializer for FSharpChoice types with various arities (2 to 6 type parameters).

classes.name: FSharpChoiceCopier
classes.description: Deep copiers for FSharpChoice types with corresponding number of type parameters.

classes.name: FSharpRefCodec
classes.description: Reference type surrogate codec for FSharpRef<T>.

classes.name: FSharpRefSurrogate
classes.description: Surrogate struct for FSharpRef<T> to assist serialization.

classes.name: FSharpRefCopier
classes.description: Deep copier for FSharpRef<T>.

classes.name: FSharpListCodec
classes.description: Surrogate codec for FSharpList<T> facilitating conversion to and from a sequence surrogate.

classes.name: FSharpListSurrogate
classes.description: Surrogate struct holding a List<T> for FSharpList<T> serialization.

classes.name: FSharpListCopier
classes.description: Deep copier for FSharpList<T>.

classes.name: FSharpSetCodec
classes.description: Surrogate codec for FSharpSet<T> converting to and from a List<T>.

classes.name: FSharpSetSurrogate
classes.description: Surrogate struct holding a List<T> for FSharpSet<T> serialization.

classes.name: FSharpSetCopier
classes.description: Deep copier for FSharpSet<T>.

classes.name: FSharpMapCodec
classes.description: Surrogate codec for FSharpMap<TKey, TValue> converting to and from a list of key-value tuples.

classes.name: FSharpMapSurrogate
classes.description: Surrogate struct holding a List of key-value pairs for FSharpMap<TKey, TValue>.

classes.name: FSharpMapCopier
classes.description: Deep copier for FSharpMap<TKey, TValue>.

classes.name: FSharpResultCodec
classes.description: Serializer for FSharpResult<T, TError>, handling success and error cases.

classes.name: FSharpResultCopier
classes.description: Deep copier for FSharpResult<T, TError>.

methods.name: WriteField
methods.description: Serializes F# types to the writer, handling reference and value cases.

methods.name: ReadValue
methods.description: Deserializes F# types from the reader, reconstructing the original value.

methods.name: DeepCopy
methods.description: Creates deep copies of F# types, respecting transactional context.

methods.name: ConvertFromSurrogate
methods.description: Converts surrogate representations back to original F# types.

methods.name: ConvertToSurrogate
methods.description: Converts F# types to surrogate representations for serialization.

methods.name: DeepCopy
methods.description: Deep copies surrogate-based F# collection types.
